question: A plane wavefront is incident normally on a plane surface separating two media. Predict the direction of the refracted wavefront. Give reason.

options.A: At normal incidence, the incident wavefront is parallel to the interface, so all its points reach the boundary simultaneously. Secondary wavelets begin simultaneously in the second medium; hence the refracted wavefront continues along the normal without deviation, though speed and wavelength may change.
options.B: At normal incidence, the refracted wavefront bends towards the normal by $90^\circ$.
options.C: At normal incidence, the refracted wavefront always bends away from the normal because speed changes.
options.D: The refracted wavefront becomes spherical because all points strike the boundary together.
